1 4.
The allegation against the petitioner is that he subjected his wife to cruelty and he was maintaining illicit relationship with his sister-in-law.
The petitioner used to assault his wife and on the day of the incident too he assaulted his wife which led to her death.

The petitioner was then booked u/s 498A/302/34 IPC.
5.
I have considered the submissions at the bar.
I have scrutinised the Case Diary.
The post-mortem report reveals that the victim had committed suicide and no mark of injury except abrasion on her forearm was detected.
Investigation has also progressed to a considerable extent.
The petitioner is a local resident.
Further custodial detention for the sake of investigation does not appear to be necessary at this stage.
There is no one to look after the petitioner's minor son who is 10 years old and his elderly parents.
He is the sole bread winner of the family.
6. Considering all aspects, the petition is allowed.

The petitioner is enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/-
with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned CJM, Morigaon under the condition that the petitioner will co-operate with the remaining part of investigation.
Send back the Case Diary.
